worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.summary: The user spins in place, winding itself into a drill, and bores its sharp beak again and again along a short axis in front: not one blow but a run of bites, each shoving the target back a little. Against an airborne target every bite bites deeper, the beak hunting the gap in the air. The only sustained-contact drill of the family.
worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.use.0: Spin into a drill and bore one target with repeated bites
worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.use.1: Shove a point-blank target back bite by bite
Bores %2$s bites, each dealing %1$s contact damage, one bite every %3$s ticks.
Beak reach %1$s blocks with a drill radius of %2$s blocks; each bite shoves the target %3$s blocks along the axis.
A grounded target takes no bonus; an airborne one takes %1$s damage per bite.
worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.deep.on: Deep drill: %1$s bites for more total damage, but each bite drops to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.deep.off: Fast drill: %1$s heavier bites (%2$s each), a quicker start and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.timing: Range %1$s blocks; spin-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.growth.0: From level %1$s each bite deepens to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.growth.1: From level %1$s each bite deepens to %2$s and one drill bores %3$s bites.
worldcombat.skill.drillpeck.preference.d: On (deep drill): +3 bites, more total damage and a bigger airborne bonus, at the cost of x0.84 power per bite, +1 bite interval, +3 spin-up, +6 cooldown and less shove. Off (fast drill): three heavier bites with a quicker start and a shorter cooldown.
